preregistration: V7-R — TEST-only completion-capacity intervention, RETRY with opportunity-conditioned sampling
status: FROZEN — pre-execution freeze; STOP before first V7-R run for operator approval
relationship_to_v7: V7 is frozen TREATMENT-UNEXPOSED / EFFICACY UNOBSERVED (TEST reached 0/3). V7-R asks the SAME causal question with the SAME runtime treatment and a sampling rule that cannot finish with zero treatment exposure.

implementation_baseline.note: unchanged since V5 — V7-R is configuration-only; no code changes

sampling_rule.rule: Run until 3 evaluable TEST treatment opportunities have occurred, OR until 9 total evaluable end-to-end runs have completed, whichever comes first.
sampling_rule.rationale: Across V6+V7, TEST was reached in 2 of 6 evaluable runs; a bounded 9-run ceiling gives the stage-level intervention a reasonable chance of observation without an open-ended 'run until success' rule.
sampling_rule.if_ceiling_hit_with_lt_3_opportunities: STOP and report that the upstream reachability problem itself prevents practical evaluation of TEST — this is a reportable outcome, not a failure of the rule.

two_cohort_denominators.workflow_cohort: N evaluable runs; TEST reached X/N — every upstream ordinary failure counts in N; failures are never replaced or hidden
two_cohort_denominators.treatment_cohort: TEST reached X; TEST cleared Y/X — only reached-TEST executions inform the treatment question
two_cohort_denominators.also_carried: PLAN reached/cleared; structural-repair invocations with direct vs repair-mediated success reported separately

accounting_rules: transport-censored run → archive, does NOT consume the evaluable cap or the 9-run ceiling
implementation/evidence/procedure defect → STOP whole block immediately
ordinary model/workflow failure or success → consumes one evaluable run
no tuning or config changes between runs, ever

PLAN/TEST outcome fields per run: direct / repair-invoked / repair max_tokens / repair terminal / repair adopted-rejected; requested max_tokens from the actual provider call for every reached synthesis turn
after the rule terminates → STOP for block review

hypotheses.H_test_progress: Raising TEST's request ceiling from 16,384 to 32,768 changes reached TEST executions from the repeated A-class zero-visible-output exhaustion observed in V6 to successful TEST completion. (Unchanged from V7 — still unobserved.)
hypotheses.H_test_persist: Reached TEST executions continue to fail despite the 32,768 ceiling, including possible A-class persistence or another TEST-local failure class.
hypotheses.H_move: TEST clears and the first workflow failure moves downstream to BUILD or later.
hypotheses.H_build_A: If BUILD is reached at its unchanged 16,384 ceiling, record whether the previously observed A-class zero-visible-output exhaustion recurs. OBSERVATIONAL ONLY — not a success/failure criterion.
hypotheses.empty_stop_observation: Preserve route identity for any empty-by-choice terminal completion. Track the OpenInference association (3/3 occurrences to date) WITHOUT route-causality claims; keep the all-completions denominator problem explicit. Do not change routing or treatment rules. NOT a primary hypothesis.

interpretation_bound: Small-sample qualifiers and explicit denominators required; descriptive A-class statement frozen in journal 16d1deb; no necessity/sufficiency overclaims; no PLAN budget raise; no routing change.
per_run_evidence: same fields as V5–V7; never persist reasoning payload text; wire observation per synthesis turn; provider counters non-authoritative when internally inconsistent.
